bounds: One cold URL, one version-query completion/rejection, one retained App event, one 15-second replay expiry, readiness and at most three application attempts. Native version is either 1 or 2. One optional document close disables further external progress.

assumptions: Weak fairness of ready and expire while their guards are enabled. An observed cold URL eventually receives an application attempt or the document closes.
Closure disables further readiness/timer/application steps and ends that document delivery obligation. Real browser scheduling, wall-clock progress and eventual application success are not proved.
No readiness or timer fairness is assumed. An observed cold URL can remain queued while an open document stutters forever, so unconditional progress is expected to fail.
